summary.en: Philippine Coast Guard, Navy and Marine Corps jointly repelled five unauthorized Vietnam-flagged fishing vessels from the waters of Kota Island in the West Philippine Sea. The PCG also deployed assets to confront a Chinese research vessel, Tan Suo Yi Hao, after it entered the area, and continues to block Chinese Coast Guard water-cannon attacks on PCG ships conducting medical evacuations at Ayungin Shoal and in the Luzon Strait. An upgraded PCG station was opened on Pag-asa Island, enhancing presence on the disputed atoll. 176 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
